newsitem.title: USA: Newell agrees to buy Insilco Rolodex unit.
newsitem.headline: Newell agrees to buy Insilco Rolodex unit.

text.p: Newell Co said Wednesday it signed an agreement to buy the Rolodex business unit of Insilco Corp.
Rolodex, with estimated 1996 revenues of $68 million ($58 million excluding divested businesses), markets office products, including card files, personal organizers and paper punches.

"Rolodex, marketed in conjunction with our Sanford, Rogers and Stuart Hall office products divisions, presents us with excellent growth opportunities," said Newell vice chairman and chief executive officer William Sovey in a statement.

Newell, with 1996 revenues of $2.9 billion, manufactures and markets high-volume consumer products which are sold through a variety of retail and wholesale distribution channels in such categories as housewares, hardware, home furnishings and office products.
